items.title: SYF (NYSE:SYF) Record Card Spending and Lower Charge-Offs Support High-End Earnings Target
items.why: Falling charge-offs at Synchrony point to healthy issuer credit quality, a useful benchmark for card credit discussions.
items.summary_ai: Synchrony reports record card spending and lower charge-offs, which support its higher-end earnings target.
items.take: Falling charge-offs at Synchrony point to healthy issuer credit quality, a useful benchmark for card credit discussions.
